pr_title: Add retries to some FSW tests
pr_body:
* Fix https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/67601 by adding retries to the ones that failed in the last 60 days. If we see this helps, we can add to others that fail or all of them.
* Fix https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/24181 and enable test
* Enable debugging output from RetryHelper showing the test that is being retried and why when an env var DEBUG_RETRYHELPER=1
* Enable console output from RetryHelper when in Helix and it's a FSW test. This will allow us to look at recent console logs to see whether retrying is happening and where.
* Remove previous custom retry method. The one test it was applied to has not recently failed.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/26308

```

| join kind=inner Jobs on JobId
| where Finished <= datetime(2022-04-04 0:00:00)
and Message contains "event did not occur as expected"
and Result == 'Fail'
```

review_comments: Ah I see the helix bool already existed. I think the new location is much better.

I wonder why is this temp directory being created inside the test file path instead of using the default constructor, which creates the folder in the system default temp folder.

I know this wasn't added by you, but made me think, since it's repeated in all the tests.
This should be done lazily, similar to how other expensive properties in PlatformDetection are initialized lazily.

I know this code was already there, but I don't think this second `TempDirectory` is necessary. Since it is being created inside the upper `testDirectory`, which happens to be a `TempDirectory`, the whole tree will be deleted on dispose.

So this folder could instead just be a `Directory.CreateDirectory(testDirectory.Path, "dir");`

actually TestDirectory and TestFile can likely be removed entirely. `GetTestFilePath()` is a file and `TestDirectory` is a root folder that will be cleaned up when the test completes due to FileCleanupTestBase. 

I'll log a bug to do that separately.
